qa.title: Q1421 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: If I play a follower's Twin Drive ability, does this follower's "Whenever a follower on your field performs a drive check" ability trigger twice?
qa.answer: Yes. When you play a follower's Twin Drive ability, it performs 2 drive checks, which will each trigger this follower's "Whenever a follower on your field performs a drive check" ability. However, you have to resolve both drive checks before resolving this follower's ability.
